rules: 1. the site's own url_patterns (newline/comma separated regexes, case-insensitive, >512 chars skipped) AND the structural floor

2. generic scene-link heuristic: same host, path depth >= 2, AND the PRODUCT's own scene-URL classifier (playlist_extractor._looks_like_scene_url) -- anchor text is NOT required, because a thumbnail anchor carries none
3. fallback, only when rules 1 and 2 select nothing: same host, path depth >= 2, title-bearing anchor (the v2 rule)
